Container.Name: GasTracker
Container.Overview:
A personal, self-hosted fuel & vehicle service tracker — a Gas Cubby style app with zero dependencies. Track fuelups, services, and reminders across multiple vehicles, see MPG and cost dashboards, and install it to your phone as a PWA. All data lives in a single SQLite file under the mapped data path.
Set a password with GASTRACKER_PASSWORD if the app will be reachable from outside your LAN, and put it behind HTTPS (iOS requires HTTPS for PWA installs from non-localhost hosts).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Enables HTTP Basic auth (any username). Leave blank for no login.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.
